What is ASTRA?
ASTRA is an on-board, AI-powered "digital flight surgeon" designed to keep astronauts healthy and safe during deep-space missions—like trips to the Moon or Mars.

The Problem It Solves:
In deep space, communication delays and radio blackouts mean astronauts can’t just call a doctor on Earth in an emergency. Meanwhile, weightlessness, cabin air changes, and space radiation put constant stress on the human body.

The Solution:
ASTRA runs 100% locally on the spacecraft’s computers (no internet or Earth connection required). It gathers health signals from smartwatches, cameras, and spacecraft sensors, predicts health risks before they become emergencies, and guides the crew on what to do next.
details:
Here is a clear, non-technical breakdown of ASTRA, organized into a ready-to-use presentation narrative. You can use this directly for slides, speaker notes, or a live demo script.

1. The Big Picture (The 30-Second Pitch)

What is ASTRA?

ASTRA is an on-board, AI-powered "digital flight surgeon" designed to keep astronauts healthy and safe during deep-space missions—like trips to the Moon or Mars.

The Problem It Solves:

In deep space, communication delays and radio blackouts mean astronauts can’t just call a doctor on Earth in an emergency. Meanwhile, weightlessness, cabin air changes, and space radiation put constant stress on the human body.

The Solution:

ASTRA runs 100% locally on the spacecraft’s computers (no internet or Earth connection required). It gathers health signals from smartwatches, cameras, and spacecraft sensors, predicts health risks before they become emergencies, and guides the crew on what to do next.

2. How ASTRA Works (Organized into 4 Core Pillars)

To keep your presentation easy to follow, organize ASTRA’s features into four logical buckets:

Pillar 1: Continuous, Effortless Health Tracking

How ASTRA gathers data without getting in the astronaut's way.

  • Smartwatch & Wearable Sync: Automatically pulls heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep quality, and activity levels from standard wearables (like Fitbit).
  • 15-Second Camera Check-In: Astronauts get tired of wearing sensors 24/7. ASTRA lets them look at a standard webcam for 15 seconds to measure pulse, breathing rate, stress, and fatigue just from subtle changes in facial color and expression.
  • Brain & Mood Check-Ins: Quick interactive brain games (testing reaction time and memory) and mood logs help catch mental fatigue before high-stakes tasks like spacewalks or docking.

Pillar 2: The "3D Digital Twin" & Smart Early Warning

How ASTRA makes sense of the data.

  • Interactive 3D Body Map: Astronauts see a 3D model of their own body color-coded from Green (healthy) to Red (needs attention) across 9 areas—from the head and heart to muscles and radiation exposure.
  • Personalized Baselines: Space changes everyone's body differently. Instead of using generic "one-size-fits-all" medical charts, ASTRA learns each astronaut's personal normal and only alerts them when something truly shifts for them.
  • Connecting the Dots (Environment + Body): ASTRA connects body data with live spacecraft data (like cabin $\text{CO}_2$ levels and NASA space radiation feeds). If an astronaut’s heart rate spikes, ASTRA knows whether it’s because they just exercised, slept poorly, or because the cabin air needs better ventilation.

Pillar 3: On-Board AI Guidance with Strict Safety Guardrails

How ASTRA helps the crew take action safely.

  • Plain-Language AI Assistant: Astronauts can ask questions like "How is my readiness today?" and get clear, empathetic answers and practical tips (e.g., "Drink more water and adjust cabin airflow").
  • Built-In Medical Safety Rules: The AI is never allowed to guess, invent numbers, or play doctor. A strict, medically verified rulebook calculates all risk levels first, and the AI simply translates those verified facts into helpful advice—automatically flagging a human doctor if a serious symptom appears.

Pillar 4: Mission Control & Privacy Protection

How doctors monitor the crew while respecting astronaut privacy.

  • Blackout-Proof Syncing: If the spacecraft loses radio contact with Earth, ASTRA safely stores all health alerts and automatically sends them to Mission Control the second the signal returns.
  • One-Click Doctor Handovers: Flight Surgeons on Earth get a prioritized crew dashboard, medical imaging/lab history, and a one-click AI Shift Summary so incoming doctors don't have to spend hours reading charts.
  • Astronaut Privacy Control: Astronauts often hide stress or poor sleep out of fear of being taken off a mission. ASTRA lets astronauts control who sees their private mental wellness notes, and blocks IT admins from ever seeing medical data.

3. Why ASTRA Stands Out (3 Key Takeaways for Your Audience)

If your audience only remembers three things about why ASTRA is special, make it these:

  1. Works Completely Offline: Built for deep-space blackouts—no cloud or Earth connection needed.
  2. Sees the Whole Picture: It doesn't just look at a smartwatch; it combines body vitals + camera scans + brain tests + cabin air + space radiation into one 3D view.
  3. Safe, Trustworthy AI: Combines strict medical rules with an easy-to-talk-to AI assistant, while protecting astronaut privacy.

4. Real-World Impact (Beyond Space)

Even though ASTRA was built for astronauts, the exact same technology solves major problems here on Earth:

  • Remote & Extreme Jobs: Submarines, polar research stations, offshore oil rigs, and military deployments where internet is unreliable and doctors are far away.
  • Hospital & Home Patient Monitoring: Proves that hospitals can use AI to monitor patients safely using local computers—keeping sensitive patient data 100% private without sending it to outside tech companies.

5. Suggested 5-Minute Live Demo Script

Follow this exact order during your presentation to tell a smooth story:

  1. The Overview (Dashboard): "Here is the astronaut’s daily home screen—an instant readiness score and a 3D health summary."
  2. The Deep Dive (3D Body Monitor): Click on the Head or Radiation zones on the 3D model. "Notice how ASTRA combines sleep, cabin air, and live NASA radiation data to explain why a specific area needs attention."
  3. The Spacecraft Environment (Environment Tab): "Here we are pulling live space station air quality and space radiation telemetry—showing how the ship's environment directly affects the crew."
  4. The Check-In & AI Chat (Camera Scanner + Assistant): Show the 15-second camera scan, then ask the AI assistant, "How is my overall health?" to show how clearly it explains the results.
  5. The Emergency & Doctor View (Emergency Button + Medical Console): Hit the Emergency button at the top, then switch to the Flight Surgeon account to show how a doctor immediately sees the alert, reviews medical scans, and generates a shift handover brief in one click.
